title: Researched facts for one page
description: Facts about the TOPIC of one page: what a law, regulator or official source says. business.json holds facts about the business; this holds facts about the world the page explains. Every fact carries the source's own words, so a reviewer can check a claim against its quote without opening the source, and `seo facts check --verify` can confirm the quote is really there. Approved at GATE 3 with the brief, then merged into brief.evidence.topic_facts by `seo facts apply`.

approved_at.description: Set by a person after reading every claim against its quote. Null means the writer must refuse the brief.

needs.description: What the brief asks the page to state, written by `seo facts init` as a research list. Informational.

claim.description: The fact in plain words, as the page may state it. Every number in it must appear in the quote.

quote.description: The source's own words, copied exactly. Not a paraphrase: this is what makes the claim checkable.

publisher_kind.description: Prefer the instrument or the regulator. 'secondary' is allowed and visible as such at review.

verified_at.description: When `seo facts check --verify` last found the quote in the source.

open_questions.description: Points the sources disagree on or do not settle. The writer is told not to assert these.
